Who are IGS?

Investigo Government Solutions (IGS) is a specialist delivery partner for government, law enforcement and public service. We combine senior consulting expertise with high-calibre, embedded capacity to help clients move fast, drive transformation, and deliver real-world outcomes that last.

Whether you're tackling major reform, stuck delivery, or a capability gap, we bring the people and the discipline to make progress visible. No inflated teams and no off-the-shelf frameworks - just smart, credible support designed around what works.

Discover more about us

Our divisions

IGS
Transform

IGS Transform works with central government departments, agencies and public bodies to deliver complex change - from strategy and digital transformation to organisational reform and performance improvement. Our consultants embed directly into delivery environments, adapt fast, and take ownership where it's needed most.

Find out more

IGS
Secure

IGS Secure provides trusted support to UK policing, law enforcement agencies, Overseas Territories, and UK-funded international programmes. We deliver hands-on change, build operational capability, and deploy experienced professionals into sensitive, high-pressure settings.

Find out more

Two missions. One mindset.

We operate across two distinct domains: central government transformation , and secure environments including policing and international reform. The contexts differ, but our mindset doesn’t. Whether we’re designing strategy, increasing capability, or stabilising delivery, we bring clarity, credibility and control to the work that matters most.

IGS Transform and IGS Secure are shaped around the needs of their sectors, but both reflect the same core standard: fast mobilisation, experienced consultants, and a focus on outcomes over optics. We flex to fit the challenge - not the other way around - and stay accountable until delivery lands.

Why IGS?

We’re not a body shop, and we’re not the Big Four. We’re a delivery-first solutions business that brings senior, outcome-focused teams, and high impact support into public sector environments - fast. Our consultants embed directly into the work, stay accountable until it lands, and don’t need a learning curve on how government works. We deliver at pace, without inflated models or passive oversight.

What sets us apart is credibility, flexibility, and momentum. Whether it’s a single interim or a full delivery team, we deploy people who’ve done it before - under pressure, in public, and with results that stick. We stabilise delivery, strengthen internal capability and hand back control when the job’s done, not when the contract ends.

Working with us

We work with experienced consultants, trusted interims, and credible practitioners who want to do meaningful work inside public service - without the noise. If you’ve delivered in central government, policing, or secure environments, and want to be part of a network that values outcomes over optics, we’d like to talk.

Our associate model is built on mutual trust, clear briefs, and work that plays to your strengths. No unnecessary handholding. No drawn-out onboarding. Just well-matched roles, sharp delivery environments, and the backing of a team that knows what good looks like.
